actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target.

actions.name: Poison Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The golem exhales poisonous gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the wraith has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mummy can use its Dreadful Glare and makes one attack with its rotting fist.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.description: The mummy targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The quasit can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a bat (speed 10 ft. fly 40 ft.), a centipede (40 ft., climb 40 ft.), or a toad (40 ft., swim 40 ft.), or back into its true form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The quasit has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Claws (Bite in Beast Form)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target.

actions.name: Scare (1/Day)
actions.description: One creature of the quasit's choice within 20 feet of it must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: The quasit magically turns invisible until it attacks or until its concentration ends. Any equipment the quasit wears or carries is invisible with it.

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.description: When the balor dies, it explodes, and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.description: At the start of each of the balor's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage. A creature that touches the balor or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The balor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.description: The balor's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The balor makes two attacks: one with its longsword and one with its whip.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. If the balor scores a critical hit, it rolls damage dice three times, instead of twice.

actions.name: Whip
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward the balor.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The balor magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.description: The blink dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The dog magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Before or after teleporting, the dog can make one bite attack.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The pixie has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Superior Invisibility
actions.description: The pixie magically turns invisible until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the pixie wears or carries is invisible with it.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bear makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw against being magically petrified. On a failed save, the creature begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified for 24 hours.

traits.name: Iron Scent
traits.description: The rust monster can pinpoint, by scent, the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of it.

traits.name: Rust Metal
traits.description: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the rust monster corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Antennae
actions.description: The rust monster corrodes a nonmagical ferrous metal object it can see within 5 feet of it. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch destroys a 1-foot cube of it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw to avoid the rust monster's touch.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.description: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.description: While in sunlight, the shadow has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

actions.name: Strength Drain
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. If a non-evil humanoid dies from this attack, a new shadow rises from the corpse 1d4 hours later.

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
traits.description: The armor is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the armor must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the armor remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal suit of armor.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The armor makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Two-Headed
traits.description: The dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dog makes two bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw against disease or become poisoned until the disease is cured. Every 24 hours that elapse, the creature must repeat the saving throw, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure. The disease is cured on a success. The creature dies if the disease reduces its hit point maximum to 0. This reduction to the creature's hit point maximum lasts until the disease is cured.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the scarecrow remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary scarecrow.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The scarecrow makes two claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the scarecrow's next turn.

actions.name: Terrifying Glare
actions.description: The scarecrow targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the scarecrow, the target must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be magically frightened until the end of the scarecrow's next turn. The frightened target is paralyzed.

name: Awakened Tree
languages: one language known by its creator

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the tree remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The captain makes three melee attacks: two with its scimitar and one with its dagger. Or the captain makes two ranged attacks with its daggers.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: The captain adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the captain must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

name: Gargoyle
damageResistances: slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the gargoyle remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an inanimate statue.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The gargoyle makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
